title: Skyline Ascent
description: A euphoric trance track in A minor at 138 BPM, 200 bars (about 5:48): intro, build, a first break where the hook enters, a riser with snare roll, a first peak, a rolling groove, a second break an octave higher, a second peak with a doubled lead and an outro. Deep kick, rolling bass, supersaw pad and lead, offbeat stabs, a pluck arpeggio and kick-driven pumping. Not listened to.
